description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for namespace-related commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common functionality such as handling namespace identifiers, resource type, and command categorization, serving as a superclass for specific namespace command implementations.

classes.name: AbstractNamespaceCommand
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared functionality for namespace commands, including namespace handling, resource typing, and JSON payload construction.

methods.name: AbstractNamespaceCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing namespace, command type, and headers with validation.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with the command.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix for namespace commands.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the command, equivalent to the namespace.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID object corresponding to the namespace.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for namespace commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, which is empty in this base class.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on class, superclass, and namespace.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality checks to ensure type compatibility.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on superclass and namespace.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends namespace information to a JSON payload with schema validation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command including the namespace.
